entries.description: Wrote session-state.json (status=in-progress, orchestrator=claude-code/claude-opus-4-7@high). Five total sessions per spec hint.

Created AccessHarvester.Pipeline/Enrichment/FunctionClassification.cs (record types + 4 enums + complexity / dependency / unresolved-fact records). Authored in-conversation per the matching-orchestrator convention.

Created AccessHarvester.Pipeline/Enrichment/FunctionClassificationBuilder.cs: visitor walking the parser AST against ResolvedModule, complexity collector, dependency-edge construction, BFS transitive-closure, sort helpers (added in round-1 fix).

Updated AccessHarvester.Pipeline.csproj (+ Vba.Parser, + Vba.Resolver) and AccessHarvester.Pipeline.Tests.csproj (+ Vba.Parser, + Vba.Resolver). Added AssemblyInfo.cs with InternalsVisibleTo for tests.

Created tests/AccessHarvester.Pipeline.Tests/FunctionClassificationBuilderTests.cs — 47 hermetic xUnit tests covering identity facets, all 5 categorization buckets, mixed/PrimaryCategory precedence, late-bound + UnresolvedReferences, cyclomatic decision-point rules, LOC/StatementCount, dependency edges + dedup, callers, transitive closure, recursion safety, BuildAll convenience, argument validation, type-library categorization Theory, determinism Theories.
dotnet build -> 0 errors, pre-existing warnings only. dotnet test -> 1278 passed, 4 skipped (Windows-only Access COM integration), 0 failed.

Cross-provider session-verification via query("gemini-pro") (preempted gpt-5-4 per prereq-set 4/4 429 calibration). Verdict ISSUES_FOUND: 1 Major (HashSet non-determinism) + 1 Minor (no test for type-library category dispatch).

Added SortEdges + SortProcedures helpers to FunctionClassificationBuilder. Marked CategorizeTypeLibraryOwner internal + added AssemblyInfo.cs InternalsVisibleTo. Added 19 new tests (16-row CategorizeTypeLibraryOwner Theory + 3 determinism tests). Build green; 1278 tests pass.
Re-verify after round-1 fixes. Verdict ISSUES_FOUND: 1 Minor (sort-order guarantee not documented in XML <summary>). Round-1 findings confirmed resolved.

Updated XML <summary> blocks on DirectDependencies / TransitiveDependencies / Callers in FunctionClassification.cs to document the sort-order contract; DirectDependencies also documents the self-reference exclusion.

Re-verify after round-2 doc fix. Verdict ISSUES_FOUND: 1 Minor (Callers <summary> missing the self-reference exclusion sentence that DirectDependencies got). Hit max-2-retries budget; per Rule 6 Minor issues do not block commit.

Added the symmetric self-reference exclusion sentence to Callers' <summary>. Recorded as fixed-without-reverification in issue-logs/session-001.json since the retry budget is exhausted; Minor-only so commit proceeds. Build green; 1278 tests still pass.

Routed analysis call produced session-1-next-orchestrator-recommendation.md — recommends Claude Code claude-opus-4-7 @ effort=high for Session 2 (Navigation Graph synthesis), same routing profile as Session 1.
Registered Session 2 in session-state.json (orchestrator=claude-code/claude-opus-4-7@high). 5 total sessions per spec.

Spec has no Session Set Configuration block; per workflow rule, requiresUAT=false, requiresE2E=false applied for the rest of this session. Session 2 plan: NavigationGraph synthesis (2 of 2 synthesis sessions) per spec hint.

Confirmed Session 1 outputs present: AccessHarvester.Pipeline/Enrichment/FunctionClassification.cs (423 LOC) and FunctionClassificationBuilder.cs (979 LOC). Cross-set prereq #14 (enrichment-queries-and-forms) change-log.md verified at session set start. Session 2 unblocked.

Created AccessHarvester.Pipeline/Enrichment/NavigationGraph.cs (record types + 4 enums for action/entry-point/target kinds + ribbon/switchboard/macro/entry-point shapes + opt-in NavigationGraphInputs). Authored in-conversation per the matching-orchestrator convention.

Created AccessHarvester.Pipeline/Enrichment/NavigationGraphBuilder.cs: visitor walking CallStatement nodes for DoCmd.{OpenForm,OpenReport,Close,BrowseTo}, literal-target extraction with VBA double-quote unescape, unresolved-target surfacing for non-literal/missing targets, sort helpers for determinism, ExpressionTextFormatter for unresolved-target text reconstruction, entry-point assembly from optional inputs in (AutoExec -> default form -> switchboard) order.

Created tests/AccessHarvester.Pipeline.Tests/NavigationGraphBuilderTests.cs: 47 hermetic xUnit tests covering empty bodies, OpenForm/OpenReport/Close/BrowseTo dispatches in bare-call and parenthesised forms, escaped-quote literal handling, WhereCondition/OpenArgs slot extraction, unresolved targets (variable/concat/function-call), source-procedure-kind Theory across all 5 procedure kinds, switchboard fixture, role-based dispatch fixture, multi-module aggregation/sort, determinism, non-DoCmd ignores, ribbon/switchboard/macro/AutoExec/default-form input pass-through.

dotnet build -> 0 errors (existing CA1416/NU1903 warnings unchanged). dotnet test --no-build -> 1317 passed, 4 skipped (Windows-only Access COM integration tests), 0 failed. Pipeline.Tests grew from 111 to 158 (+47 new NavigationGraph tests).

Cross-provider session-verification via query("gemini-pro") (preempted gpt-5-4 per Session-1 calibration). Verdict VERIFIED, issues=[]. Note: verifier returned 24 output tokens (JSON block only, no preceding prose analysis); JSON-block-present + VERIFIED clears commit per Rule 6, but the terseness is logged for calibration.
